name: Liveshare VR
summary:
Liveshare VR puts you where the camera is.

EXPLORE IN 360°
Stand on a mountain summit in Slovenia, fly over Alaskan glaciers, watch a rocket launch or sit in the square during a medieval festival. Browse the library by category, then look around in a window or tap Enter VR to be surrounded by it.

JOIN A LIVE MOMENT
